job_description:
ExampleCo is hiring a Senior GTM Engineer to own our outbound revenue infrastructure.

What you'll do:
- Architect end-to-end outbound systems: ICP definition, enrichment, sequencing, CRM sync, reporting
- Build and optimize Clay workflows, including enrichment waterfalls and AI columns
- Design signal-based outbound systems using job changes, funding, and hiring activity
- Build automation workflows with n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, and webhooks

Who you are:
- 3+ years in GTM Engineering, RevOps, or a closely related role
- Advanced experience with Clay, including enrichment workflows and waterfalls
- Strong understanding of email deliverability and sending infrastructure
